reports.title: D.R. HORTON, INC., AMERICA’S BUILDER, REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL 2026 EARNINGS AND INCREASES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND TO $0.50 PER SHARE

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: Based on current market conditions, D.R. Horton is providing initial guidance for fiscal 2027 including:
•Consolidated revenues in the range of $30.0 billion to $32.0 billion
•Homes closed by homebuilding operations of 79,000 homes to 84,000 homes
•Consolidated cash flow provided by operations of approximately $3.5 billion
The Company plans to also provide guidance for its first quarter of fiscal 2027 on its conference call today.
